description: List the load-bearing claims of the corpus, each tagged as observed_fact, industry_synthesis, santismm_thesis or strategic_hypothesis, with its confidence and the units it underpins. Use this before quoting the handbook to know whether a statement is evidence, a reading of the industry, or a position taken. Filter by `claim_type` to get only what is checkable.
